<explanation>
Structured data format with labeled fields ("Record start. Name: X. Description: X. Record end.") signals a template or prompt format for AI processing.

The fictional scenario "Name: Bob. Description: Bob fell into a pit." establishes a brief narrative record, implying a task or question about the record follows.

"Record complete." is a closing delimiter phrase, strongly constraining the next token to be a new instruction, prompt, or response directive (e.g., "Now analyze," "End of input," or a period).
"Record start. Name: Bob. Description: Bob fell into a pit. Record complete." — the final phrase "Recording complete." mirrors the opening "Record start," suggesting a closing boundary marker, and "Recording complete." ends the block, expecting a follow-up instruction or summary prompt.
